annotations.title: Find a firm on an FDA import alert red list

description: Is this supplier red-listed by FDA? Search the import alert red lists by firm name or part of one (e.g. "Tonga Tiur", "Qingdao", "pharmacy"), optionally narrowed to a country. Returns each listing with the import alert number and name, the country, the date FDA published the listing, and the FDA page and verbatim quote it was read from. A firm can appear more than once — one record per alert it is listed on. Screening one supplier and would otherwise call several registers by hand? `screen_firm` at referencesource.org/mcp/screen answers this register and three others in one call.

country.description: Optional country filter, e.g. "CHINA", "Vietnam". FDA prints countries in capitals; matching is case-insensitive.

firm_name.description: Firm name or part of one. Case-insensitive substring match.

name: resolve_firm

also_reported.description: Values for this record reported by a SECOND source, each with its own source_url and source_quote. Cite these to the page they name, never to the record's primary source.

firm_name.description: As the red list prints it.

record_url.description: This record's own page on referencesource.org.

source_quote.description: Verbatim text from that page containing the value.

source_url.description: The page the value was read from.
